entries.title: 1 orchestrator-root file preserved/merged during update
entries.detected:
During an orchestrator-root update pulling from `vco_upstream/main`, 1 user-editable file(s) had both local and upstream changes. VCO ran a per-path 3-way merge before `git pull`:
  - `docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md` — conflict; local preserved, upstream saved as `docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md.from-upstream-5a9ae53` (base=ef6ec75 theirs=5a9ae53)
entries.why_deferred: Default-to-safety: when a file in the user-editable allowlist (`CLAUDE.md`, `knowledge/**/*.md`, `.claude/CONTEXT_STATE.md`, `.claude/MEMORY.md`, etc.) has both local edits and upstream edits, VCO auto-merges non-overlapping changes but PRESERVES local content when the merge has conflicts. The upstream version is saved alongside as `<path>.from-upstream-<sha>` so you can inspect or accept it manually.
entries.command_to_apply:
# Inspect the upstream version side-by-side with your local:
#   diff -u <path> <path>.from-upstream-<sha>
#
# Accept upstream (overwrite local with the upstream version):
#   mv docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md.from-upstream-5a9ae53 docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md    # POSIX
#   move docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md.from-upstream-5a9ae53 docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md   # Windows cmd.exe
#
# OR keep your local edits and delete the upstream sidecar:
#   rm docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md.from-upstream-5a9ae53      # POSIX
#   del docs/VCT_MODULE_MANIFEST_SPEC.md.from-upstream-5a9ae53     # Windows cmd.exe
#
# Auto-merged files were already written to the working tree;
# review them with `git diff HEAD`.

entries.title: KG access rows restored to binding-backed collection names

entries.why_deferred: Informational record of an automatic, evidence-gated repair (phantom name absent on Weaviate, binding-backed sibling present).
entries.command_to_apply: # No action needed — the access rows were already restored.

entries.title: Code-graph resync did not fully converge
entries.detected: A background code-graph resync for project 'LegacyPrefix' finished but stale rows remain (LegacyPrefix_CodeModule: 2, LegacyPrefix_CodeClass: 1, LegacyPrefix_CodeFunction: 9). Retrieval still works via the previously stored vectors; the stale rows are just not re-embedded under the current revision yet.
entries.why_deferred: Background resyncs are best-effort and never force-applied. Re-running the command below re-embeds only the remaining stale rows (cheap, resumable). This entry is written once and clears automatically when a later update's probe confirms zero stale rows.

entries.title: Project-level template review pending
entries.detected:
VCO ships minimal-stub templates for CLAUDE.md, CONTEXT_STATE.md, and MEMORY.md to give fresh projects a starting point. 2 file(s) in this project meaningfully differ from the current shipping reference — that's expected for established projects, but you may want to review whether any new sections (e.g. `Session Start Discipline`, `KG-First Search Policy`) are worth pulling in:
  - `.claude/CONTEXT_STATE.md`
  - `CLAUDE.md`
entries.why_deferred: Project-level files are bespoke (CLAUDE.md sections, CONTEXT_STATE.md state) — VCO never overwrites them. The reference templates ship as `.reference.md` sidecars under `.claude/context/templates/` so you can diff and selectively adopt.
entries.command_to_apply:
# Compare each file against VCO's reference template:
#   diff -u /home/user/Projects/DemoRoot/<file> /home/user/Projects/DemoRoot/.claude/context/templates/<NAME>.reference.md
# Adopt structure/sections you want; keep your project-specific
# content. The reference files refresh on every install run, so
# they always reflect VCO's current shipping shape.
# To silence this nudge without changing anything:
python -m vco_lib.project_init dismiss-deferral --folder '/home/user/Projects/DemoRoot' --condition-id template_review_pending
